request: Stapel mir pro Monat, was 2025 auf Strom, Versicherung, Handy und Abos gegangen ist.

plan.title: Fixkosten pro Monat, gestapelt
plan.question: spending in 2025 in the categories Housing, Insurance, Communication and Subscriptions per month, one row per month and category and never two rows for the same pair, columns month as 'YYYY-MM', topic and total_eur

sql:
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month,
       CASE WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%strom%' THEN 'Strom'
            WHEN lower(description) LIKE '%versicherung%' THEN 'Versicherung'
            ELSE 'Sonstiges' END AS topic,
       ROUND(-SUM(amount), 2) AS total_eur
FROM transaction_view
WHERE amount < 0 AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY month, topic
ORDER BY month, topic
reasoning_plan:
die Anfrage ist deutsch, also language de
vier Kategorien ueber zwoelf Monate, zwei Dimensionen, die sich kreuzen
'stapel' verlangt gestapelte Balken, und die Monatssumme bleibt lesbar
die Gruppe kommt aus der Kategorie der Buchung, nie aus dem Buchungstext
die Spalten sind Monat, Kategorie und die Euro-Zahl, die Zahl zuletzt
reasoning_code:
the shape is bar_stacked, so barY carries a series and no layout
the columns are month, topic, total_eur, and total_eur holds the numbers
topic is the series, so it is the z and the color channel and it needs a legend
months on x on a band scale, euros on y from the bare factory
every chart carries the tooltip and its euros are written with eur

request: How did the rent on our joint account add up over 2025?

plan.title: Rent added up over 2025
plan.question: rent paid from the joint account to Immobilien Schmid in 2025 added up over the months, one row per month, columns month as 'YYYY-MM' and cumulative_eur

sql:
SELECT month, ROUND(SUM(spent) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS cumulative_eur
FROM (SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', booked_on) AS month, -SUM(amount) AS spent
      FROM transaction_view
      WHERE amount < 0 AND account = 'Sparkasse Stuttgart Gemeinschaftskonto' AND (lower(coalesce(title, counterparty, description)) LIKE '%immobilien schmid%') AND booked_on BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31'
      GROUP BY month)
ORDER BY month
reasoning_plan:
the request is written in English, so language en
'add up over 2025' is a running total
a running total over ordered months is an area
the request names the joint account, so only that account is asked for
the columns are the month and the cumulative euro figure
reasoning_code:
the shape is area, so areaY draws the band and lineY its edge
the columns are month and cumulative_eur, and cumulative_eur holds the numbers
months on x with monthShort, euros on y
